description: Runs independent adversarial review rounds with fresh internal subagents that attack artifact assumptions, happy paths, failure scenarios, and evidence gaps through formal /vs_review/ reports and mandatory response closure.

changes: Publish the subagent-vs-review skill for fresh internal subagent adversarial review rounds.
Define formal /vs_review/ report requirements with review input, reviewer outputs, main-agent response, and closure status.
Add dynamic reviewer selection and blocking-finding re-review rules.
Require reviewer launch records and trace sources so fresh session and no-context-inheritance claims are auditable.
Embed adversarial review as artifact-focused falsification of assumptions, happy paths, failure scenarios, and evidence gaps throughout the workflow.
